final_validation.compiled_sql:
SELECT department.name AS department, sum(attendance_record.worked_minutes) AS total_worked_minutes, sum(attendance_record.late_minutes) AS total_late_minutes, sum(attendance_record.absence_minutes) AS total_absence_minutes 
FROM attendance_record JOIN employee ON employee.id = attendance_record.employee_id JOIN department ON department.id = employee.department_id 
WHERE attendance_record.work_date >= '2026-06-01' AND attendance_record.work_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY department.name
